description: Two-view swapped prediction cross-entropy using temperature-scaled prototype scores and detached soft assignment codes. Each example averages the two cross-view directions (Caron et al., §3 Eqs. (1)–(2), Appendix A.1); structured-objective bindings follow src/topologies/training/recipes/structured_objective.py:36-50.

examples.title: Train a two-view predictor with SwAV loss

name: SwAV swapped prediction loss

parameters.additional parameters: temperature is the only accepted key in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because targets are soft assignment codes, not indexed labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point raw prototype scores shaped [B,2,K] with B > 0 and K >= 2
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example directional averages, mean averages examples, or sum totals examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point soft assignment codes shaped [B,2,K], with each view nonnegative and summing to one; targets are detached
parameters.temperature: finite positive real scalar applied before prototype softmax (default 0.1)
